cover.headline: Hogies takes down the top seed
cover.dek: The Usurper rolls up to the Number 1 Seed Club in a gold Lamborghini, and the bouncers wave him straight in. Marissa catches the Lester in her safe, Tyler finally ends the slide in Liberty City, Sgt. Bob's skeleton crew runs down Abdo, Mo burns down Tim's mansion, and the Trade God sticks up Tyriese.
side: New No. 1
Hogies is 9–2, has clinched a playoff spot and holds the top seed. Sean is 8–3 and has the most points by 102, but he's waiting in line for now.
Upset Sunday
Bob won as a +380 underdog, Zach as +205 and Marissa as a 2-point dog. The favorites went 3–3.
Last spot
Abdo is 5–6 and holds the 7th seed. Tyler, Collin, Marissa and Tim are all one game back at 4–7 with three weeks left.
Bench pain
Tyriese (Stroud) and Collin (Germie Bernard) each lost a game they'd have won with one lineup swap.

stories.headline: The Kingpin falls: Hogies storms the mansion and takes the empire
body: The cameras caught all of it. The convoy came through the gate, the crew breached the mansion, and by Monday night Hogies had his feet up on the Kingpin's desk with a cigar in one hand and Sean's scotch in the other. Sean was a **−8.5** favorite and the fans picked him 3–2. Oscar picked Sean 149–141, and Oscar was wrong. Hogies scored **169.30**, the top score of the week, and the game went **12 points over** the 295 total.

Oscar said whoever got more out of Dallas would win, and Hogies did. **Dak Prescott scored 35.90**, the best score on the field, and **George Pickens added 23.80**, for 59.70 from the Cowboys. **Chuba Hubbard scored 26.00**, **Chris Olave 19.20**, and new arrival **Zay Flowers 16.40** in his debut. Cam Skattebo's debut was quieter at 5.80, and Hogies didn't need more.

The Kingpin got his own Cowboys going. **CeeDee Lamb scored 30.20** and **Javonte Williams 24.10**. **Emmett Johnson added 24.30** and **DJ Moore 23.10**. Kenneth Walker and Brock Bowers, both questionable all week, didn't make it into the lineup. The vault was cracked somewhere else. **The Vikings D/ST scored 0.00** while the **Bears D/ST scored 16.00 on Sean's bench**. **Khalil Shakir scored 15.30** on the bench while Ryan Flournoy scored 2.10. J.K. Dobbins started and scored 0.00. Even with both swaps, Sean scores 167.40 and still loses by **1.90**. One more twist: Sean's tight end, Mason Taylor, scored 4.50, and Hogies had cut him on Tuesday.

Hogies moves to **9–2** and takes the **No. 1 seed** with three weeks left. Sean falls to **8–3**, his three-game winning streak is over, and for the first time since Week 8 he's looking up at someone. The Usurper has the empire. Now he has to keep it.
locker: Thirty-six points. The Usurper said bring the whole convoy. I brought the whole offense.
Oscar picked the Kingpin and the gate held for about a quarter. Oscar did warn the Kingpin to be nervous. Nobody listens to Oscar.

stories.headline: Mission passed: Marissa catches the Lester in her safe and sends him to lockup
body: Collin made it onto *The Villains Queen*, got below deck and had the drill on the safe. Then Marissa walked in holding a pistol. The sportsbook had Marissa at **−2**, and she covered by 2.66. The fans picked Collin 4–1, and they were wrong. Oscar picked Marissa 127–123 and was within two points on both teams. The game went 2 points over the 251.5 total.

The Queen's security did the job. **Travis Kelce scored 25.40**, **Patrick Mahomes 24.96** in his first start with Drake Maye out, and **Tetairoa McMillan 19.10**. Saquon Barkley added 13.50, and **Cam Little** and the **Broncos D/ST** each scored **13.00**. Courtland Sutton started and scored 0.00, and Kenny Gainwell's 9.90 sat on the bench. She didn't need it.

The Lester got the drill most of the way through. **Jahmyr Gibbs scored 27.80**, **Jameson Williams 19.30** and **Breece Hall 19.00**. **Kirk Cousins scored only 7.40**. The heist came down to the one call Collin got backwards. Last week he started Germie Bernard over Malachi Fields, and Bernard scored 1.00 while Fields scored 9.20 on the bench. This week he flipped it: **Fields started and scored 4.50**, while **Bernard scored 10.00 on the bench**. Starting Bernard would have won it by **0.84**.

Both teams are now **4–7**. Marissa has won the Week 11 battle and is still alive at the back of the playoff race. Collin is wearing an orange jumpsuit with "Yacht heist" on his booking card. The mastermind should have stayed home.
locker: The Queen said nobody touches the safe. I take my job seriously.
Oscar warned that the first time Lester left the house, he'd run into an armed woman. Oscar did not expect to be right about the score too.

stories.headline: Mission passed: Tyler's luck turns in Liberty City, and the champ hits a new low
body: Last year's two finalists met on the curb in Liberty City, and only one of them got up. Tyler was a **−5** favorite and covered by 20. The fans liked Shmoody 4–1, and Oscar went with the fans and the upset at 121–118. Everyone was wrong except the sportsbook. The game went 9 points over the 236.5 total.

Tyler spent his bus fare well. New pickup **Cam Ward** started over Jared Goff and outscored him, **22.22** to 20.36. **Jonah Coleman scored 34.90**, the best score on the field, and **Ladd McConkey added 20.70** after a week as questionable. **Bucky Irving**, the one thing Tyler didn't sell, scored **19.00**, and the **Texans D/ST** added **15.00**. Carnell Tate scored 13.80 in his first game since coming over from Hogies. DK Metcalf scored 1.20 and Jordyn Tyson 2.00, and Antonio Williams had 21.20 on the bench. It didn't matter. The five-game losing streak is over.

Shmoody's fortune kept sliding. **Ashton Jeanty scored 27.90**, **Parker Washington 18.30** and **Nico Collins 14.80**. The new quarterback, **Bo Nix**, scored **11.50** while **Aaron Rodgers scored 15.98 on the bench**. Kyle Monangai scored 1.80, and Jakobi Meyers had 12.50 on the bench. A perfect lineup still loses.

Tyler moves to **4–7** and is one game behind Abdo for the last playoff spot with three weeks left. Shmoody falls to **2–9**. The 2025 trophy is in a trash can somewhere in Liberty City. Repeat champ? Not this year.
locker: Coach finally stopped trading. I finally started scoring.
Oscar picked the upset and got the toilet bowl. Oscar would like to point out that he was technically right about who ended up in it.

stories.headline: Mission passed: Sgt. Bob's skeleton crew runs down Abdo and ends the five-star manhunt
body: Half of Bob's unit was on leave. The other half caught the getaway car. Bob was a **+380** underdog getting **30.5** points, and he won by 22.54. The fans picked Abdo 4–1, and Oscar picked him 118–96. Everyone was wrong except the sergeant. With seven of Bob's players on bye or out, the game went **20 points under** the 207.5 total, the lowest line of the week.

Sgt. Bob's reinforcements did the job. **Brock Purdy scored 22.20**, the best score on the field, and the **49ers D/ST added 15.00**. The players Bob called in off waivers all showed up: **Samaje Perine scored 13.70**, **Mike Gesicki 12.70** and kicker **Jason Sanders 11.00**. Chris Godwin and Xavier Hutchinson combined for only 7.60. A unit of backups was all Bob needed.

Abdo's getaway car ran out of gas. He found a quarterback off waivers, **Bryce Young**, who scored **15.96**. **Christian McCaffrey**, Oscar's getaway driver, was held to **14.20**, and Jonathan Taylor to 6.70. Omarion Hampton added 10.30 and Xavier Worthy 11.80, but Ja'Kobi Lane started and scored 0.00, and Tyler Warren scored 3.20. The best player in the game didn't play like it, and the helicopter caught up.
Bob moves to **7–4** and stays in the race for a bye. Abdo falls to **5–6**. He's still holding the last playoff spot, but Tyler, Collin, Marissa and Tim are all one game behind at 4–7.
locker: The Sergeant called me Tuesday and said report for duty. I didn't even know where practice was.
Oscar said chasing a man is harder with half the squad car empty. Sgt. Bob made it look easy with half a squad car.

stories.headline: Mission passed: Mo burns down Tim's mansion, and the quiet life is over
body: Tim was sitting by the pool calling it another easy win. Then the pickup pulled into the driveway. Mo didn't need a big day to do it: he scored only **104.56**, and it was still 27 more than Tim. Mo was a **−30** favorite and all five fans picked him. Oscar picked Mo 151–116 and got the winner, but not the cover. With both teams missing half their crews to byes, the game went **83 points under** the 265.5 total.

Mo lit the match with his receivers. **Malik Nabers scored 18.50**, and **Justin Jefferson added 13.70**. Kicker **Tyler Bass scored 17.00**, the second-best score on Mo's team. Josh Allen scored only 12.16, Ja'Marr Chase 8.10 and Isaiah Likely 4.50. On most weeks that would be a disaster. Against Tim it was plenty.

Tim's mansion burned down to the foundation. His **77.54** was the lowest score of the week. **Derrick Henry scored 19.10**, and Chimere Dike added 13.30 as one of the replacements for his Packers on bye. After that it was mostly ash. **Trevor Lawrence scored 12.74**, Chase Brown 8.60, and Michael Mayer 1.40 at tight end. Spencer Shrader kicked 1.00, and the **Bengals D/ST scored 0.00**.

Mo has won three straight and is **6–1** since starting 0–4. He moves to **6–5**, and the Smoke Boy belt is still around his waist. Tim has lost **five straight** and falls to **4–7**, one game out of the last playoff spot with three weeks left. The retirement didn't work out.
locker: Coach Mo didn't even need the gas can. Tim's house was already on fire.
Oscar has never seen a man retire successfully in this league. Oscar has now seen what happens when one tries.

stories.headline: Mission passed: the Trade God jumps out from behind the tree and walks off with the dog
body: The dog didn't bite. Zach had been waiting behind that tree for two weeks, and on Sunday he finally made his move. Tyriese was a **−255** favorite giving **17.5**, the fans picked him 3–2, and Oscar picked him 139–127. Zach won outright as a **+205** underdog. With both teams stuck in the mud, the game went **72 points under** the 269.5 total.

Zach did it with no real running backs. Zonovan Knight and Emari Demercado combined for 10.40, as expected. Everyone else picked up the slack. **George Kittle scored 18.40**, **Jayden Daniels 17.06** and **Amon-Ra St. Brown 14.70**. **Rashee Rice added 11.30**, **Brandon Aubrey 10.00** and the **Steelers D/ST 9.00**. Not one Zach starter scored 20. He didn't need one.

Tyriese got robbed by his own bench. Oscar said he had too many good options at quarterback, and he picked the wrong one: **Caleb Williams started and scored 14.34**, while **C.J. Stroud scored 20.46 on the bench**. That swap alone wins the game by **0.80**. **Mike Evans**, questionable all week, played and scored **22.90 on the bench** while Tank Dell started and scored 5.70. **D'Andre Swift**, the dog on the leash, scored 11.90, and the **Buccaneers D/ST scored −1.00**. **James Cook led the team with 17.20**.
Zach snaps his two-game losing streak and moves to **7–4**, tied with Bob. Tyriese's three-game winning streak is over, and he falls to **6–5**. The salesman finally got sold.
locker: Coach told me to stay behind the tree until the dog looked away. It took two weeks.
Oscar admired a man who brings running backs more than a man who brings a knife. Oscar has learned the knife is enough.

news.headline: Hogies hangs the No. 1 seed in the trailer
news.body: Hogies has hung the top seed on the wall of his job-site trailer, next to the Quiet Zone sign. He celebrated with exactly one Miller Lite, because the contract says one on a work night.

news.headline: $WAVY coin dips 31 points
news.body: After losing the top seed, Sean's cryptocurrency dropped exactly 31.10 points overnight. Sean has told every holder to buy the dip. Nobody has.

news.headline: Marissa adds a security system to the yacht
news.body: Marissa has installed motion sensors, a second safe and a framed booking photo of Collin in the yacht's lobby. She also caught Zach on the dock twice and says that's a separate problem.

news.headline: Collin files 40-minute appeal from jail
news.body: Collin has filed an appeal arguing that he would have won if he'd started Germie Bernard. The appeal was 40 minutes long and included three unrelated facts about octopuses.

news.headline: Tyler's streak is over
news.body: Tyler snapped his five-game losing streak and was seen walking back into the commissioner's office for the first time in a month. Cam Ward has been given a corner office.

news.headline: Shmoody files an Amazon return for 2026
news.body: Shmoody has tried to return the 2026 season for a full refund. The return window closed in September. Customer service suggested he try again next year.

news.headline: Sgt. Bob awards medals to his reserves
news.body: Sgt. Bob held a medal ceremony for Samaje Perine, Mike Gesicki and Jason Sanders, the reserves who ran down Abdo. Jaxon Smith-Njigba watched from his bye week and asked when his medal was coming.

news.headline: Abdo posts 'lol' to the group chat
news.body: After losing as a 30-point favorite, Abdo posted 'lol' to the league chat and muted it. He's still in the 7th seed, which he says is 'all part of the plan.'

news.headline: Mo is 6–1 since 0–4
news.body: Mo has asked the league office to start counting his record from Week 5. The league office declined. He has added a third notch to the Smoke Boy belt anyway.

news.headline: Tim's homeowner's insurance does not cover Mo
news.body: Tim has filed a claim for the damage to his Vinewood mansion. The insurance company says visits from Mo count as an act of God.

news.headline: The Trade God buys a second knife
news.body: After his stick-up worked, Zach has bought a second knife and hidden behind a different tree. Bob has been told to watch his back this week.

news.headline: Tyriese sells the bench, gets 20 points for it
news.body: Tyriese has put C.J. Stroud and Mike Evans up for sale after they combined for 43.36 points on his bench. The asking price is one apology each.

parlay.headline: Oscar goes 9-for-12
parlay.golden: Golden leg cashes: Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 98 yards and two touchdowns
parlay.note: Oscar's best slip of the season. CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens, D'Andre Swift, Jahmyr Gibbs, Tetairoa McMillan, Bucky Irving, Christian McCaffrey, Derrick Henry and Malik Nabers all scored. Gibbs scored twice. The misses were Luther Burden, Parker Washington and Deebo Samuel, the danger leg.
parlay.sign: Nine of twelve. Oscar was told to mix in receivers, and five of the seven he took found the end zone. The danger leg lived up to its name.

rank-2026-11.title: The Usurper's empire
rank-2026-11.summary: Hogies storms the mansion and takes the top spot. Sean slides to second, Bob and Zach climb after their upsets, and Tyler jumps four spots after finally ending his losing streak. Shmoody drops to last.
rank-2026-11.note: Rank movement is calculated against the published Week 10 Gazette rankings. These are Oscar’s editorial power rankings, not official playoff seeding.

entries.take: 169.30, the top score of the week, against the Kingpin himself. Clinched a playoff spot and took the No. 1 seed. Dak and Pickens keep building the empire.
Still the most points in the league by 102. Lost the top seed with the Bears D/ST and Khalil Shakir's 31.30 on the bench. Still the most dangerous team in the league.
Three straight wins, 6–1 since 0–4, and the second-most points in the league. He won with 104.56, which says more about Tim than about Mo.
Won as a +380 underdog with seven players on bye or out. His waiver pickups delivered. Get the starters back and this team is a problem.
Beat Tyriese as a 17.5-point underdog with no real running backs. Kittle, Daniels and Amon-Ra did enough. The Trade God is back in the race for a bye.
Left C.J. Stroud and Mike Evans on the bench for 43.36 points and lost by 5.32. The winning streak is over, and the playoff spot is no longer safe.
Lost as a 30-point favorite, and McCaffrey was held to 14.20. Still in the 7th seed, but four teams are one game behind him.
Ended the five-game losing streak with 135.22. Jonah Coleman scored 34.90, and the Cam Ward pickup paid off. One game out with three to play.
